title: announce_store accept(): failed floor write leaves stale cache entry that can regress the durable state
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-t8ox. rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:394-403: on the durable path, write(iid,false,next) commits the new state record, then write(iid,true,next)? at line 401 early-returns Err(Io) on failure, skipping remember(iid,next) at line 403. For an existing pin, load(iid) at line 378 cached the OLD state, so after the failed accept: cache=old, durable state=new, durable floor=old. Every subsequent load() takes the cache fast path (308-311) and returns the old state despite the durable record holding the new one, and a subsequent accept() validates against the stale cached state, so a replayed/held announce with old.seq < seq < new.seq (RFC 1982) passes the seq_gt check at 383 and is written over the newer durable state record - the sealed state regresses and an already-seen announce is re-accepted. The header's state-then-floor crash analysis (lines 10-13) assumes a crash destroys the cache; a non-fatal floor-write error (ENOSPC/EIO on the floor root) violates that while the cache survives. Fix: on the floor-write error path, self.records.remove(iid) before returning Err so the next load() rebuilds from disk (state=new, floor=old lag heals forward to new). Removal is the fail-safe option; caching next also works since durable state is next, but removal is simpler.
close_reason: Fixed in 64bdfc03bc: accept() evicts the IID cache entry when the floor witness write fails after the state commit (removes the stale pre-accept state that could otherwise re-validate a replayed intermediate sequence over the newer sealed state); module doc extended to cover the non-crash failure case; regression test failed_floor_write_evicts_stale_cache_and_load_rebuilds added (detaches floor_storage to drive the exact Err(Io) path, asserts durable state advanced on disk via raw record bytes, same-store load rebuilds to the durable state, replay of seq 150 rejected after heal, floor advances, restart serves seq 201). Verified: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib announce 52/52 green on heft; clippy -D warnings clean.
